the isotopic approach is a valuable tool to identify and quantify water sources, and to assess the impact of water losses and leaky sewers on the urban water cycle.
water isotopes can be used for a wide range of applications including source partitioning, water loss quantification, and groundwater contamination assessment.
dual isotope endmember analysis can be applied for quantifying water source mixing in urban groundwater systems.
